title: Danganronpa: Trigger Happy Havoc
description: The first mainline entry, centered on Makoto Naegi and the students trapped inside Hope's Peak Academy.

title: Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair
description: The second mainline entry, following Hajime Hinata and a class trapped on Jabberwock Island.

title: Danganronpa Another Episode: Ultra Despair Girls
description: A third-person action spin-off following Komaru Naegi and Toko Fukawa in a city overrun by Monokumas and the Warriors of Hope.

title: Danganronpa V3: Killing Harmony
description: The third mainline entry, introducing a new group of students and a new killing game.
